title: What If You Stood on a Comet? Gravity Almost Vanishes

scenes.text: What if you stood on a comet? Gravity there is almost nothing.
Comet 67P is about four kilometers long. Its gravity is roughly ten thousand times weaker than Earth's.
Europe's Philae lander found out. It touched down at one meter per second, and its harpoons failed to fire.
It bounced about one kilometer back up and drifted for nearly two hours.
It hit a cliff, bounced again, and finally settled after a second hop of seven minutes.
Nothing pulls you down there. A gentle one-meter-per-second touchdown turned into a two-hour trip.
